risks.title: Dependence on decentralized governance model
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned implicitly in Items 50-52: risk management is not formally centralized but distributed by department. Moderate language ('adequately proven') but repeated recognition of the need for continuous monitoring. Stable trend, but decentralized organizational structure creates potential vulnerability.

risks.title: Complex and evolving regulatory compliance
risks.score_rationale: Items 50-54 detail exposure to multiple regulatory frameworks (Law 140/2015, Decree-Law 109-E/2021, CBAM). Moderate-to-high intensity language ('permanent monitoring', 'continuous'). Trend up: new obligations (CBAM, whistleblowing) added in 2023. High category weight for a listed group.

risks.title: Risk of loss of independence of the external auditor
risks.score_rationale: Items 42-46: Deloitte provided 63% of non-audit services (210k€ out of 333k€ in 2023). Moderate intensity language ('safeguarding independence is key criterion'). Stable trend but concentration of services with a single auditor. High category weight for a listed company.

risks.title: Absence of formal external auditor rotation policy
risks.score_rationale: Item 44: Ramada explicitly acknowledges not having a formal rotation policy despite post-2016 legal requirements. Justificatory language ('not common practice', 'never identified loss of independence') but reveals potential non-compliance. Stable trend but risk of regulatory criticism.

risks.title: Management of emerging environmental and social risks
risks.score_rationale: Items 50, 54: Human Rights and Community Participation policies adopted May 2023 (recent). Moderate intensity language ('increasingly decisive role', 'increasing focus'). Trend up: new policies and CBAM obligations. Growing category weight for an industrial group.

risks.title: Risk of undetected fraud and irregularities
risks.score_rationale: Item 49: Whistleblowing mechanism in place but no reports in 2023. Neutral language ('no reports received'). Stable trend but absence of reports may indicate underreporting or weak culture. Moderate category weight.

risks.title: Dependence on continuity of management team
risks.score_rationale: Items 50-54: Risk management heavily relies on 'operational managers' and 'management teams' with no mention of succession planning. Implicit language of dependence ('managers identify risk factors'). Stable trend but structural risk unaddressed. Moderate category weight for a decentralized group.

risks.title: Exposure to raw material price volatility
risks.score_rationale: Item 53: Risk of raw material price variability explicitly identified as a market risk factor. Factual language but no detail on specific exposure. Stable trend but relevant for an industrial group. High category weight for operational activities.
